output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast Dec 19

Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage again. Wanted to see about getting our christmas breakfast on the books at your place, Saturday Dec 19 in the back room at 7am same as always. If the 19th is no good could you do the 12th instead? The 19th would be our first choice if you have it.

Dwayne got me the list off the board and we have 24 right now, thats counting Earl and his wife Carol. Can you handle that many in the back room? I'll be the one to get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you asked last year, so you don't have to chase different people around or make more food than we need.

Can we do the same breakfast as last year, the family style eggs, home fries and biscuits and gravy, with everybody ordering there own meat off the menu? The $11 a head was fair and if its gone up a little thats fine, just let me know what it is now so I can tell everybody ahead of time. Separate checks again please if thats still ok, that worked good for us.

Couple things on the food and getting in. Patsy can't do eggs anymore. Could she get oatmeal or pancakes instead, or whatever you have thats easy enough to do along with ours? Let me know what would work for her and if thats a different price. And Lonnie is on a walker since his hip. Can we have him come through the side door with no steps? Will that be unlocked that early or should I come get somebody when he gets there? Just want to make sure he can get in without having to fool with the steps.

This year we want to do a little something for Earl too, but please keep that part quiet. He don't know anything about it. He's retiring after 31 years driving and his last day is Dec 18, the day before breakfast if we get our first date. Carol says he'd be embarrassed by a big speech so we aren't looking to make a big production out of it, just something with everybody there.

Would it be ok to bring a cake from Sugarcreek, or could you do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls and we put a candle in one for him? Your cinnamon rolls are better than any cake anyway and Earl loves them. I'm leaning that way if its something you can do. Let me know what a tray big enough for the group would cost. If bringing a cake is easier on your end just say, I haven't ordered one.

Also on the coffee, I know you felt bad about the urn quitting last year around 8:15, nobody was upset with you. You mentioned having a backup next time, could we make sure theres another pot handy this year just in case? We do go through a lot of it and I'd hate for you to get caught short again. Is the bottomless coffee still the same deal?

Let me know about the date and all that when you get a chance. We always enjoy coming there and appreciate you taking care of us.

Thanks,
Gary
